I understand that's frustrating. Let me help you sort this out.

First, can you check your bank app to see if one of the charges says "pending"? Pending authorisations drop off in **3–7 business days** automatically—Leafy can't release them faster.

If **both charges have posted** (not pending), I can process a duplicate refund. Please reply with:
- Your order number: **LF-310022** ✓
- The **last four digits of the card** used

Once I have that, the duplicate refunds within **3 business days** to your original card. Card refunds typically show in **5–10 business days** after that, depending on your bank.
